simple.meaning: בֵּרִי (Bêrîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “(only in the plural and with the article) the Berites , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֵּרִי (H1276) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֵּרִי (H1276) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֵּרִי (Bêrîy) / H1276 is traced through 2 Samuel 20:14 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H1276. Beri בֵּרִים 2Sam 20:14 obscure, many after ᵑ9 read בַּחֻרִים ; Klo prefers חַבִּכְּרִים after ᵐ5 & so Dr. בְּרִית see below II. ברה ; see also אֵל 3 בַּעַל 4 בֹּרִית see below ברר .

occurrences.englishText: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, and to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.
